purpose: Measure the open_questions classifier on the `ai jev route` default ladder (anthropic only). The earlier held-out runs sent all three built-in ladders.
command: cargo run --example jev_open_questions_eval -- heldout-inputs.json OUTPUT_DIR 2 anthropic
inputs: heldout-inputs.json, byte-identical (the frozen 34 held-out states, labels unchanged)
cost_note: No billing receipt available. Raw usage and exact requests are retained; no dollar amount invented.
crate_version: omni-dev 0.45.0, built from this branch with the example's LADDERS argument
not_measured: Per-citation could_be_cheaper noul questions (production adds one per open cited issue; all 34 held-out states cite other issues) and --effort-advice questions. Both are left out of baseline and augmented alike.
